subject: Next steps: identifying funding owner and procurement path for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: identifying funding owner and procurement path for Redwood pilot

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for a great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side: 

- Summary: Neurolytics is interested in a 6-week pilot to validate latency and cost improvements for your realtime annotator pipeline.
- Success criteria we heard: reduce inference tail latency to <120ms p95, and a 30% reduction in per-token cost versus current setup.
- Blockers you mentioned: procurement timeline, SOC2 evidence, and internal owner for budget sign-off.

Can you confirm who will be the economic/budget owner for the pilot (name & role)? That will help us scope approvals and draft a commercial outline. Also: do you want us to loop your procurement and security teams now, or after we send the MVP scope?

I attached a short 2-page pilot scope (redwood-pilot-MVP-scope.pdf) and a checklist of security artifacts we can produce. Proposed next steps:
1) You share budget owner + procurement contact (this week)
2) Redwood sends a one-page commercial outline and SOW draft (by Mon)
3) Joint kick-off call with procurement/security if needed (schedule availability)

If easier, we can run a short call with whoever owns the budget to align on the pilot ROI and approval path. 

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
(415) 555-0143

Attachment: redwood-pilot-MVP-scope.pdf (2 pages)
Attachment: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@neurolytics.ai>

Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 17:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: identifying funding owner and procurement path for Redwood pilot

Thanks, Markus — great summary and very clear.

Quick answers: 
- Budget owner: Katrine Moore, VP Product (katrine.moore@neurolytics.ai). Katrine owns reserve budget for pilots and will be the approver for a $40–60k pilot.
- Procurement: Jamal Reed (cc'd) handles commercial terms and PO routing; procurement inbox procurement@neurolytics.ai is the official intake.
- Security: We will need SOC2 Type II and a brief data flow diagram for the pilot; Jamal can route the checklist to our security team.

I'll introduce Katrine on the thread once Jamal confirms timing. For now, Jamal — can you share the standard timelines for a pilot contract and any required vendor forms?

Thanks for the ping. Typical timeline for a pilot contract and onboarding here: 1–2 weeks review (procurement/legal), then PO issuance within 3–5 business days after approvals. 

A few notes for Redwood to prep: 
- We need a short vendor security packet (SOC2 attestation, encryption at rest/in transit notes). The checklist Alicia attached looks good — please send the filled responses where items are N/A or available.
- Contract: we prefer a short Master Services Agreement with an exhibit for the pilot SOW; our legal team will redline.
- PO: we will issue a PO against the agreed SOW; payment terms 30 net are standard.

Cc'ing Katrine Moore once she confirms — Alicia, please add her to the thread when convenient.

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Alicia and Jamal's responses. Two asks from my side: 

1) Marissa — can you take point on compiling the vendor security packet & answer the checklist items (security-evidence-checklist.xlsx)? Jamal wants the filled responses and any supporting links (SOC2 report, encryption notes).
2) Ben — once we have the commercial outline (I’ll draft the one-pager), can you lead the negotiation of standard pilot terms and prepare a short MSA template for procurement? Highlight any clauses we should avoid for pilots (long termination notice, high liability caps).

I'll follow up with a one-page commercial outline by Monday morning and will include a suggested SOW that matches the success criteria. We should also be prepared to run a 30-minute alignment call with Katrine if she prefers a live ROI discussion.

Thanks team — I’ll loop Katrine after we have the security packet and one-pager ready.

Best,
Markus
